title.en: Diplomatic and Consular Relations (Asian Development Bank) Order 2020

completenessNote: 全文，共 8 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Order is the Diplomatic and Consular Relations (Asian Development Bank) Order 2020.

heading.en: Immunities and privileges in addition to those in Asian Development Bank Act 1966

text.en: 3. The immunities and privileges conferred on the ADB, the head of Office and any officer or staff member of the Office are in addition to those conferred on the ADB, the head of Office and any officer or staff member of the Office by the Asian Development Bank Act 1966 and International Organisations (Immunities and Privileges) (Asian Development Bank) Order 2020.

heading.en: Immunities and privileges of head of Office

text.en: 5. The head of Office enjoys the like immunities and privileges that are accorded under Articles 29 to 35, 36(2) and 39 of the Vienna Convention on Diplomatic Relations to a diplomatic agent.

heading.en: Immunities and privileges of officers or staff members of Office

text.en:
7. The ADB may waive any immunity or privilege mentioned in paragraph 5 or 6 in any case where the ADB is of the opinion that —
(a)the immunity will impede the course of justice; and
(b)the immunity can be waived without limiting the interests of the ADB.

8.—(1) Paragraphs 5 and 6 do not apply to any citizen or permanent resident of Singapore.
(2) Nothing in this Order affects the right of the Government to take measures that it considers useful to safeguard national security, public safety or health, or to maintain law and order.
